say:4:1622502004:1.text: North of Lumivale lies an old stretch of woods known as <style="highlight">Silentwood</style>.
say:4:1622502004:1.source_cn: 事情是这样，求知魔法村北部那片古老的森林，民间称之为<...

say:5:1622502005:1.text: The rumor goes that a giant tree deep inside that can <style="highlight">mimic a person's voice. It draws wanderers toward it</style>, then swallows them whole and feeds on their flesh and blood.
say:5:1622502005:1.source_cn: 传闻森林深处盘踞着一棵巨树，<style=highli...

say:6:1622502006:1.text: Because of that, the locals keep one unspoken rule. <style="highlight">If you must go in, stay silent.</style> And if you hear a voice calling to you, assume it's the tree pretending to be human.
say:6:1622502006:1.source_cn: 因此有一条不成文的规定在民间流传：<style=hig...

say:7:1622502007:1.text: Lately, folks have gone missing. Some swear they've heard crying at the edge of the forest... We've got to do something about it.
say:7:1622502007:1.source_cn: 近来，禁语森林内失踪事件频发，甚至有人在森林边缘听到哭...

choice_prompt:8:1622502007.text: Lately, folks have gone missing. Some swear they've heard crying at the edge of the forest... We've got to do something about it.
choice_prompt:8:1622502007.source_cn: 近来，禁语森林内失踪事件频发，甚至有人在森林边缘听到哭泣声……绝不能再置之不理了。

say:9:1622502008:1.text: As far as the stories go, <style="highlight">people simply call it the giant tree. No proper name was ever passed down.</style>

say:10:1622502009:1.text: None of our records mention one either.
say:10:1622502009:1.source_cn: 根据我们所掌握的资料，也从未提到过它有名字。

choice:8:0:1.text: This tree... does it have a name at all?
choice:8:0:1.male: This tree... does it have a name at all?
choice:8:0:1.female: This tree... does it have a name at all?

say:11:1622502010:1.text: There are a few <style="highlight">survivors</style> living near the <style="highlight">wheat fields</style>. They made it out of the forest alive, so they might know something the rest of us don't.

say:12:1622502011:1.text: If you're up for it, we can head there now and see what they'll tell us.
say:12:1622502011:1.source_cn: 如果你愿意，我们不妨现在就动身去询问他们。
say:12:1622502011:1.male: If you're up for it, we can head there now and see what they'll tell us.
say:12:1622502011:1.female: If you're up for it, we can head there now and see what they'll tell us.

choice:8:1:2.text: Do we have anything else to work with?
choice:8:1:2.male: Do we have anything else to work with?
choice:8:1:2.female: Do we have anything else to work with?

say:13:1622502012:1.text: I appreciate it. With you on this case, we might finally get a straight answer about what's happening in that forest.
say:13:1622502012:1.source_cn: 感谢你愿意伸出援手，我相信以你的智慧，一定能查清背后的真相。
say:13:1622502012:1.male: I appreciate it. With you on this case, we might finally get a straight answer about what's happening in that forest.
say:13:1622502012:1.female: I appreciate it. With you on this case, we might finally get a straight answer about what's happening in that forest.

choice:8:2:3.text: Alright. Let's find out what's really going on.
choice:8:2:3.male: Alright. Let's find out what's really going on.
choice:8:2:3.female: Alright. Let's find out what's really going on.

choice:3:0:1.text: Alright. What exactly is going on?
choice:3:0:1.male: Alright. What exactly is going on?
choice:3:0:1.female: Alright. What exactly is going on?

say:15:1622502003:1.text: Normally I would. But this time... we need someone who won't panic when things turn strange, and someone strong enough to handle whatever shows up. That someone is you.
say:15:1622502003:1.source_cn: 这次调查危机四伏，我们需要一位拥有强大魔法力量，又具备...
say:15:1622502003:1.male: Normally I would. But this time... we need someone who won't panic when things turn strange, and someone strong enough to handle whatever shows up. That someone is you.
say:15:1622502003:1.female: Normally I would. But this time... we need someone who won't panic when things turn strange, and someone strong enough to handle whatever shows up. That someone is you.

choice:3:1:2.text: You must have other people you could ask.
choice:3:1:2.male: You must have other people you could ask.
choice:3:1:2.female: You must have other people you could ask.

say:0:1622503001:0.text: A giant tree with no name...
say:0:1622503001:0.source_cn: 无名巨树？看来需要亲自去霍尔特商业街，找幸存者厘清线索了。
say:0:1622503001:0.male: A giant tree with no name...
say:0:1622503001:0.female: A giant tree with no name...

say:0:1622506001:0.text: Look over there. That old man's one of the survivors. Maybe he'll talk.
say:0:1622506001:0.source_cn: 看，那位老人就是幸存者，不妨与他聊聊。

say:0:1622507001:0.text: Survivor? That'd be me! I walked out of that forest myself.
say:0:1622507001:0.source_cn: 幸存者？我是从森林里走出来过

say:1:1622508001:1.text: You're here about the forest? Then you're talking to the right man. I made it out safe and sound!
say:1:1622508001:1.source_cn: 你们是来打听森林的事吗？我呀，是从里面安全走出来过！
say:1:1622508001:1.male: You're here about the forest? Then you're talking to the right man. I made it out safe and sound!
say:1:1622508001:1.female: You're here about the forest? Then you're talking to the right man. I made it out safe and sound!

say:2:1622508002:1.text: And don't pay attention to the things people say. All that talk about danger and whispers is nonsense. The forest isn't that frightening, and that big tree everyone fears... it's a gentle big fellow!
say:2:1622508002:1.source_cn: 外头传的什么禁语啊危险啊，都是胡说八道！森林一点儿也不...

choice_prompt:3:1622508002.text: And don't pay attention to the things people say. All that talk about danger and whispers is nonsense. The forest isn't that frightening, and that big tree everyone fears... it's a gentle big fellow!
choice_prompt:3:1622508002.source_cn: 外头传的什么禁语啊危险啊，都是胡说八道！森林一点儿也不可怕，那棵巨树更是个好家伙！

say:4:1622508003:1.text: Well, it all started years ago. My cat <style="highlight">Bibi</style> wandered off...

say:5:1622508004:1.text: Ah, Bibi... big amber eyes, fluffier than a dandelion. I still miss that little rascal...
say:5:1622508004:1.source_cn: 唉，我的包包啊，它那琥珀色的眼睛，毛茸茸的身子，像个小...

say:6:1622508005:1.text: Now where was I... right, the forest. I went in to look for my Bibi and got lost the moment I stepped under the trees. I was wandering around like a fool with no idea which way was which.
say:6:1622508005:1.source_cn: ……哎，刚说到哪了？哦对，我进了森林里找包包，结果一进...

say:7:1622508006:1.text: I kept going until I was dizzy and ready to give up. That's when I ran into the giant tree... and a kind fellow named Perri. They pointed me toward the right path, and that's the only reason I made it out.
say:7:1622508006:1.source_cn: 我兜兜转转、头晕眼花，正不知往哪走时，是巨树和一个叫皮...

choice_prompt:8:1622508006.text: I kept going until I was dizzy and ready to give up. That's when I ran into the giant tree... and a kind fellow named Perri. They pointed me toward the right path, and that's the only reason I made it out.
choice_prompt:8:1622508006.source_cn: 我兜兜转转、头晕眼花，正不知往哪走时，是巨树和一个叫皮瑞的好心人，给我指了路，我这才走出来。

say:9:1622508007:1.text: Of course I did! That thing is huge. You'd need a dozen people just to wrap your arms around it. <style="highlight">Deep-green bark</style>, leaves so thick they block out the sky. Feels like standing under a giant umbrella.
say:9:1622508007:1.source_cn: 当然！那棵巨树啊，粗壮得十几个人都抱不过来，<styl...

say:10:1622508008:1.text: And the bark has these deep lines. If you look closely, it's almost like an <style="highlight">old man</style> smiling down at you.
say:10:1622508008:1.source_cn: 树干上还有一道道纹路，凑近了看，像一张<style=h...

choice:8:0:1.text: So you really saw the giant tree yourself?
choice:8:0:1.male: So you really saw the giant tree yourself?
choice:8:0:1.female: So you really saw the giant tree yourself?

say:11:1622508009:1.text: Perri told me he was a <style="highlight">professor from the Lyceum</style>. Said the forest had a special kind of life energy and he came to study it.

say:12:1622508010:1.text: He treated that tree like an old friend. Claimed he could understand it too, knew its moods and all.
say:12:1622508010:1.source_cn: 他把巨树当老朋友，能听明白巨树的语言，懂它的脾气。

choice:8:1:2.text: And this Perri... who is he?
choice:8:1:2.male: And this Perri... who is he?
choice:8:1:2.female: And this Perri... who is he?

say:13:1622508011:1.text: No... Never did. But I never forgot the kindness Perri and the tree showed me that day.
say:13:1622508011:1.source_cn: 包包……终究是没找着。但我心里一直记着他俩的好。

say:14:1622508012:1.text: That's why I don't buy the scary stories. That forest isn't evil. Not to me.
say:14:1622508012:1.source_cn: 所以别人怎么说我都不信，那森林，明明是个善地。

choice:8:2:3.text: I see. And did you ever find your cat?
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 原来如此，你找到包包了吗？
choice:8:2:3.male: I see. And did you ever find your cat?
choice:8:2:3.female: I see. And did you ever find your cat?

choice:3:0:1.text: Then tell us what happened that day.
choice:3:0:1.male: Then tell us what happened that day.
choice:3:0:1.female: Then tell us what happened that day.

say:0:1622509001:0.text: Oh, cut it out, Jorge. You old fool!
say:0:1622509001:0.source_cn: 住口！豪尔赫，你这老糊涂！

say:1:1622510001:1.text: Stop feeding people those tall tales! How many more folks do you want stumbling in there because you make it sound harmless?!
say:1:1622510001:1.source_cn: 豪尔赫，收起你那套骗人的鬼话！你还要用它害死多少人才够？！

say:2:1622510002:1.text: I believed you once. And the vines almost strangled the life out of me!
say:2:1622510002:1.source_cn: 我当初就是信了你，结果差点被勒死在藤蔓里！

say:4:1622510003:1.text: Saro, you're not exactly young anymore, and you're still as hot-headed as ever! Why would I lie about any of this?
say:4:1622510003:1.source_cn: 萨略，都一把年纪了，你还是那么急躁！我……我怎么可能骗...

choice_prompt:5:1622510003.text: Saro, you're not exactly young anymore, and you're still as hot-headed as ever! Why would I lie about any of this?
choice_prompt:5:1622510003.source_cn: 萨略，都一把年纪了，你还是那么急躁！我……我怎么可能骗人呢……

say:6:1622510004:1.text: Listen to me. Don't trust a word out of that fool's mouth. That giant tree is evil to the core!
say:6:1622510004:1.source_cn: 年轻人，你千万别相信豪尔赫说的话！禁语森林里那棵巨树，...

say:7:1622510005:1.text: Back then... Jorge was my best friend.
say:7:1622510005:1.source_cn: 我当初……我当初把豪尔赫当作最好的朋友。

say:8:1622510006:1.text: And because of his stories, I ignored every warning about the giant tree. Every single one.
say:8:1622510006:1.source_cn: 就是因为他说的那些鬼话，所以即便外面关于巨树的传闻说得...

say:9:1622510007:1.text: "Stories"? I told the truth. All of it.
say:9:1622510007:1.source_cn: 鬼话？我说的全都是真的。

say:10:1622510008:1.text: Don't start that again. I'm done being fooled by you!
say:10:1622510008:1.source_cn: 老滑头，你现在可骗不了我了！

say:11:1622510009:1.text: I went into the forest alone. I thought I'd find Jorge's stupid cat and bring it back as a surprise.
say:11:1622510009:1.source_cn: 再后来，我独自进了森林，想把豪尔赫那只蠢猫给找回来，给...

say:12:1622510010:1.text: And then, I heard Jorge calling for help. Clear as day. I ran toward the sound...
say:12:1622510010:1.source_cn: 结果呢？我在森林里里听见豪尔赫的声音在呼救，循着声音过去……

say:13:1622510011:1.text: Next thing I knew, the vines from that tree wrapped around me tight. So tight I could barely breathe! I thought that was the end of me!
say:13:1622510011:1.source_cn: 可下一秒，就被那棵邪恶巨树的藤蔓死死缠住！那力气大得吓...

say:15:1622510013:1.text: Oh shut it! If I hadn't learned a bit of fire magic in my youth and burned the thing, I'd be dead! The flames scorched its <style="highlight">dark brown bark</style> and its <style="highlight">twisted face</style>, and the pain made it loosen its grip long enough for me to escape.
say:15:1622510013:1.source_cn: 你闭嘴！要不是我年轻时学过点火焰魔法，拼命放出火烧它，...

say:16:1622510014:0.text: As it let go, I heard it muttering to itself. Something about <style="highlight">killing Perri</style>. I didn't stop to listen. I ran for my life!
say:16:1622510014:0.source_cn: 它松开我的时候，我亲耳听到它自言自语，那声音像是在炫耀...

say:17:1622510015:1.text: You must have lost your wits in there, Saro!
say:17:1622510015:1.source_cn: 你一定是吓糊涂了，萨略！

say:18:1622510016:1.text: The giant tree's bark is deep green, healthy-looking, gentle even! There is nothing evil about it!
say:18:1622510016:1.source_cn: 巨树先生的树皮是墨绿色的，看起来是那么健康、那么和善！

say:19:1622510017:1.text: And hurting Perri? Never. Perri was kind, and the two got along like old pals! Your story doesn't add up.
say:19:1622510017:1.source_cn: 而且，它怎么会伤害皮瑞先生呢，皮瑞先生那么好心，他们可...

say:20:1622510018:1.text: Oh come on! You can't even remember where your own cat went, yet you defend a monster that fools people for a living! You were tricked. Plain and simple!
say:20:1622510018:1.source_cn: 你个老顽固！你连自己的猫在哪儿都记不清楚，还在这里替树...

say:21:1622510019:1.text: You're the one mistaken. You never looked closely...
say:21:1622510019:1.source_cn: 是你弄错了……你根本没看清楚……

say:22:1622510020:1.text: Not closely? I almost died, Jorge. I saw more than enough. You're hopeless!
say:22:1622510020:1.source_cn: 我没看清楚？我差点把命都丢在里面看清楚！你真是无药可救！

say:24:1622510021:1.text: Gentlemen, please. Let's slow down for a moment.

choice_prompt:25:1622510021.text: Gentlemen, please. Let's slow down for a moment.

say:26:1622510022:1.text: He's the one who needs calming.

say:28:1622510026:1.text: The two old men keep going, neither able to convince the other.
say:28:1622510026:1.source_cn: 两位老人的争吵愈发激烈，谁也说服不了谁。
say:28:1622510026:1.male: The two old men keep going, neither able to convince the other.
say:28:1622510026:1.female: The two old men keep going, neither able to convince the other.

say:29:1622510027:1.text: Their long friendship now looks as fractured as their stories about the forest.
say:29:1622510027:1.source_cn: 他们曾经坚固的友情，如同他们对森林的认知一样，出现了一...
say:29:1622510027:1.male: Their long friendship now looks as fractured as their stories about the forest.
say:29:1622510027:1.female: Their long friendship now looks as fractured as their stories about the forest.

say:32:1622510024:1.text: Me. I saw everything with my own eyes.
say:32:1622510024:1.source_cn: 你该信我，我是亲眼所见。

say:33:1622510025:1.text: And I nearly lost my life. That counts for something!

choice:25:1:2.text: Alright, alright. Who's actually telling the truth here?
choice:25:1:2.male: Alright, alright. Who's actually telling the truth here?
choice:25:1:2.female: Alright, alright. Who's actually telling the truth here?

choice:5:0:1.text: Alright, hold on. Why are your stories so different?
choice:5:0:1.male: Alright, hold on. Why are your stories so different?
choice:5:0:1.female: Alright, hold on. Why are your stories so different?

choice:5:1:2.text: Tell me what happened to you.
choice:5:1:2.male: Tell me what happened to you.
choice:5:1:2.female: Tell me what happened to you.

say:1:1622511001:1.text: <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, this is much more complicated than I expected.
say:1:1622511001:1.male: <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, this is much more complicated than I expected.
say:1:1622511001:1.female: <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, this is much more complicated than I expected.

say:2:1622511002:1.text: I'm stretched thin with county matters and emergency cases coming in every day. I'm sorry, but you may have to continue the forest investigation on your own for now.
say:2:1622511002:1.source_cn: 但星湖郡治安事务众多，近期更是有不少突发案件……很抱歉...
say:2:1622511002:1.male: I'm stretched thin with county matters and emergency cases coming in every day. I'm sorry, but you may have to continue the forest investigation on your own for now.
say:2:1622511002:1.female: I'm stretched thin with county matters and emergency cases coming in every day. I'm sorry, but you may have to continue the forest investigation on your own for now.

say:3:1622511003:1.source_cn: 根据豪尔赫与萨略所言，<style=highlight...
say:3:1622511003:1.male: From both their accounts, <style="highlight">Perri</style> seems to be the key. <style="highlight">Head back to the Lyceum, look into his records, and confirm whether he really was a professor there</style>.
say:3:1622511003:1.female: From both their accounts, <style="highlight">Perri</style> seems to be the key. <style="highlight">Head back to the Lyceum, look into his records, and confirm whether he really was a professor there</style>.

say:4:1622511004:1.text: When I finish these urgent matters, I'll meet you <style="highlight">near the wheat fields</style>.
say:4:1622511004:1.source_cn: 待我处理完突发事务后，我们便在<style=highl...

say:5:1622511005:1.text: Sorry to leave this on your shoulders. Be careful out there.
say:5:1622511005:1.source_cn: 抱歉让你独自行动，请务必谨慎行事。
say:5:1622511005:1.male: Sorry to leave this on your shoulders. Be careful out there.
say:5:1622511005:1.female: Sorry to leave this on your shoulders. Be careful out there.

say:0:1622512001:0.text: This is getting tricky. Better head back to the campus first and confirm who Perri actually was.
say:0:1622512001:0.source_cn: 是有些棘手，还是先行返回学院查阅资料，确认皮瑞的身份吧。
say:0:1622512001:0.male: This is getting tricky. Better head back to the campus first and confirm who Perri actually was.
say:0:1622512001:0.female: This is getting tricky. Better head back to the campus first and confirm who Perri actually was.

say:0:1622513001:0.text: If Jorge wasn't making things up, Perri's file is going to be old. Might take some digging to find it.
say:0:1622513001:0.source_cn: 如果豪尔赫没有说谎，那皮瑞的资料已十分久远了，看来得好...
say:0:1622513001:0.male: If Jorge wasn't making things up, Perri's file is going to be old. Might take some digging to find it.
say:0:1622513001:0.female: If Jorge wasn't making things up, Perri's file is going to be old. Might take some digging to find it.

say:0:1622514001:0.text: So the tree has a name... and Perri was real. There must be more records somewhere.
say:0:1622514001:0.source_cn: 根语……原来巨树有名字，皮瑞也真的存在，应该还有其他记...
say:0:1622514001:0.male: So the tree has a name... and Perri was real. There must be more records somewhere.
say:0:1622514001:0.female: So the tree has a name... and Perri was real. There must be more records somewhere.

say:0:1622515001:0.text: Could Jorge have been telling the truth after all?
say:0:1622515001:0.source_cn: 难道豪尔赫说的才是真相？或许还存有研究记录，再仔细找找。
say:0:1622515001:0.male: Could Jorge have been telling the truth after all?
say:0:1622515001:0.female: Could Jorge have been telling the truth after all?

say:0:1622516001:0.text: This is getting complicated. Best bring the research log and check things out in the forest.
say:0:1622516001:0.source_cn: 看来事情有些复杂，还是带上研究记录，去森林亲自探查情况吧。
say:0:1622516001:0.male: This is getting complicated. Best bring the research log and check things out in the forest.
say:0:1622516001:0.female: This is getting complicated. Best bring the research log and check things out in the forest.

say:0:1622518001:0.text: That's odd... Those cries don't sound normal. Let's turn into a wolf and see what they're trying to say.
say:0:1622518001:0.source_cn: 反常的叫声……变形为狼，听听它们想说什么。
say:0:1622518001:0.male: That's odd... Those cries don't sound normal. Let's turn into a wolf and see what they're trying to say.
say:0:1622518001:0.female: That's odd... Those cries don't sound normal. Let's turn into a wolf and see what they're trying to say.

say:1:1622519001:0.text: S-stop right there... Don't go into the forest.
say:1:1622519001:0.source_cn: 站、站住……别往森林里走了。

say:3:1622519002:0.text: Meow... the forest isn't what it used to be. It's dangerous in there now!
say:3:1622519002:0.source_cn: 喵，森林里可不比从前了，现在里面可危险了！

choice_prompt:4:1622519002.text: Meow... the forest isn't what it used to be. It's dangerous in there now!
choice_prompt:4:1622519002.source_cn: 喵，森林里可不比从前了，现在里面可危险了！

say:5:1622519003:0.text: Meow... Back then, it was a wonderful playground! But that was a long, long time ago.
say:5:1622519003:0.source_cn: 喵……从前可好了！那可是很久很久以前的事了。

say:6:1622519005:0.text: My dad told me, and his dad told him, and he heard it from his own granddad...
say:6:1622519005:0.source_cn: 我是听爸爸说的，爸爸是听爷爷说的，爷爷又是听它的爷爷说的……

say:7:1622519006:0.text: Back in our ancestor Bibi's time, our whole clan lived deep inside the forest!
say:7:1622519006:0.source_cn: 在我们的先祖包包那个年代，我们整个族群都住在森林最深处呢！

choice_prompt:8:1622519006.text: Back in our ancestor Bibi's time, our whole clan lived deep inside the forest!
choice_prompt:8:1622519006.source_cn: 在我们的先祖包包那个年代，我们整个族群都住在森林最深处呢！

say:9:1622519007:0.text: Huh? Impossible! That's classified feline lore reserved for whiskered elites!
say:9:1622519007:0.source_cn: 咦？你怎么会知道？这可是喵谱上的绝密记载！
say:9:1622519007:0.male: Huh? Impossible! That's classified feline lore reserved for whiskered elites!
say:9:1622519007:0.female: Huh? Impossible! That's classified feline lore reserved for whiskered elites!

say:10:1622519008:0.text: Our ancestor did stay in the human world for a while. A two-legs named Jorge served him faithfully.
say:10:1622519008:0.source_cn: 先祖它确实在人类世界停留过一阵，是有个叫豪尔赫的两脚兽...

say:11:1622519009:0.text: Ancestor Bibi said Jorge took good care of it, but the forest was a lot more exciting than the human world. So it snuck off on its own and ended up meeting a friendly giant tree and a kind human!
say:11:1622519009:0.source_cn: 先祖说豪尔赫伺候得不错，但森林冒险更有趣！于是它闯入森...

say:12:1622519010:0.text: Those were good days. The giant tree and the human looked after the forest, guided lost travelers, and even let Bibi build a home inside the tree hollow. That's how our whole clan came to be!
say:12:1622519010:0.source_cn: 那时候可舒服了，巨树和那个人类会保护森林，为迷失者指引...

say:13:1622519011:0.text: But then... the human disappeared. And the giant tree changed. It got scary. It started lashing out at anything that came near!
say:13:1622519011:0.source_cn: 可是后来……后来那个人类不见了，巨树变得好可怕，经常发...

say:14:1622519012:0.text: My grandpa was one of the ones... *Sobbing*
say:14:1622519012:0.source_cn: 呜呜，我爷爷就是被巨树……呜呜……

say:15:1622519013:0.text: Our clan had to move further and further out just to stay safe. By my generation, we could only hang around the edges. Soon we might have to beg in the two-legged world just to survive!
say:15:1622519013:0.source_cn: 唉，我们族群的栖息地因此被迫离森林越来越远，到我这一代...

say:16:1622519014:0.text: *Sobbing*... I heard two-legs have no sense of boundaries and always try to pet us. It's terrifying...
say:16:1622519014:0.source_cn: 呜呜……听说两脚兽很没有边界感，会乱摸我们，真可怕……

say:17:1622519015:0.text: So please, stay away from the forest!
say:17:1622519015:0.source_cn: 喵呜，所以说，不要再往森林里进啦！
say:17:1622519015:0.male: So please, stay away from the forest!
say:17:1622519015:0.female: So please, stay away from the forest!

choice:8:0:1.text: Bibi? As in Jorge's missing cat?
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 包包？难道是豪尔赫的猫？
choice:8:0:1.male: Bibi? As in Jorge's missing cat?
choice:8:0:1.female: Bibi? As in Jorge's missing cat?

choice:4:0:1.text: What do you mean "used to be"?
choice:4:0:1.male: What do you mean "used to be"?
choice:4:0:1.female: What do you mean "used to be"?

say:19:1622519004:0.text: Of course we do. We were born in there. We just haven't gone home in a long while...
say:19:1622519004:0.source_cn: 当然啦，我们可是在森林里出生的呢，虽然已经很久没回去了……

choice:4:1:2.text: You two know what's been happening in the forest?
choice:4:1:2.male: You two know what's been happening in the forest?
choice:4:1:2.female: You two know what's been happening in the forest?

say:1:1622520002:0.text: If something eats you, that's on you. We did our part!
say:1:1622520002:0.source_cn: 被吃了可别怪我们没提醒你！
say:1:1622520002:0.male: If something eats you, that's on you. We did our part!
say:1:1622520002:0.female: If something eats you, that's on you. We did our part!

say:0:1622521001:0.text: It's unnervingly quiet... Better take a look around.
say:0:1622521001:0.source_cn: 真是安静得可怕，先四处调查一番吧。
say:0:1622521001:0.male: It's unnervingly quiet... Better take a look around.
say:0:1622521001:0.female: It's unnervingly quiet... Better take a look around.

say:0:1622522001:0.text: These plants look corrupted. Like the kind of rot I saw in the Dark Forest.
say:0:1622522001:0.source_cn: 这的植物似乎受到了腐化，与过去在薄暮丛林见到的情况有些相似。
say:0:1622522001:0.male: These plants look corrupted. Like the kind of rot I saw in the Dark Forest.
say:0:1622522001:0.female: These plants look corrupted. Like the kind of rot I saw in the Dark Forest.

narration:0:1622523001:1.text: As you investigate, a frenzied owl suddenly swoops down on you...
narration:0:1622523001:1.male: As you investigate, a frenzied owl suddenly swoops down on you...
narration:0:1622523001:1.female: As you investigate, a frenzied owl suddenly swoops down on you...

say:0:1622525001:1.text: It's completely overcome by corruption. You'll have to purify it first before getting information.
say:0:1622525001:1.source_cn: 这只狂暴的猫头鹰充盈着腐化的气息，净化它后，或许能问出...
say:0:1622525001:1.male: It's completely overcome by corruption. You'll have to purify it first before getting information.
say:0:1622525001:1.female: It's completely overcome by corruption. You'll have to purify it first before getting information.

narration:1:1622525002:1.text: There... your magic is working. Its eyes are clearing up.
narration:1:1622525002:1.male: There... your magic is working. Its eyes are clearing up.
narration:1:1622525002:1.female: There... your magic is working. Its eyes are clearing up.

say:0:1622526001:0.text: Good. It's calm now. I'll switch to wolf form so I can understand what it's trying to say.
say:0:1622526001:0.source_cn: 看来净化生效了，或许它掌握着一些线索，变为狼形与它谈谈好了。
say:0:1622526001:0.male: Good. It's calm now. I'll switch to wolf form so I can understand what it's trying to say.
say:0:1622526001:0.female: Good. It's calm now. I'll switch to wolf form so I can understand what it's trying to say.

say:1:1622527001:1.text: Please... tell me... how is Perri? Did the letter... reach the tree?
say:1:1622527001:1.source_cn: 呼……呼……皮瑞先生……皮瑞先生怎么样了？信……信送到了吗？

choice_prompt:2:1622527001.text: Please... tell me... how is Perri? Did the letter... reach the tree?
choice_prompt:2:1622527001.source_cn: 呼……呼……皮瑞先生……皮瑞先生怎么样了？信……信送到了吗？

say:3:1622527002:1.text: Perri asked me to take a letter to the giant tree... but... what happened to the forest? This isn't how it was...
say:3:1622527002:1.source_cn: 皮瑞先生委托我送给巨树大人的信……不对……森林怎么变成...
say:3:1622527002:1.male: Perri asked me to take a letter to the giant tree... but... what happened to the forest? This isn't how it was...
say:3:1622527002:1.female: Perri asked me to take a letter to the giant tree... but... what happened to the forest? This isn't how it was...

say:4:1622527004:1.text: I... I don't remember... Ooch, my head... Was I corrupted in the end...?
say:4:1622527004:1.source_cn: 我……我这是……呜，头好痛……我……我是不是终究还是被...
say:4:1622527004:1.male: I... I don't remember... Ooch, my head... Was I corrupted in the end...?
say:4:1622527004:1.female: I... I don't remember... Ooch, my head... Was I corrupted in the end...?

choice_prompt:5:1622527004.text: I... I don't remember... Ooch, my head... Was I corrupted in the end...?
choice_prompt:5:1622527004.source_cn: 我……我这是……呜，头好痛……我……我是不是终究还是被那股黑暗腐化了？
choice_prompt:5:1622527004.male: I... I don't remember... Ooch, my head... Was I corrupted in the end...?
choice_prompt:5:1622527004.female: I... I don't remember... Ooch, my head... Was I corrupted in the end...?

say:6:1622527005:1.text: So it happened... the worst of it! This is my fault! Magister, you freed me from the corruption. Maybe... maybe you can help me make this right...
say:6:1622527005:1.source_cn: 果然……最坏的情况还是发生了！都怪我！尊贵的魔法师大人...
say:6:1622527005:1.male: So it happened... the worst of it! This is my fault! Magister, you freed me from the corruption. Maybe... maybe you can help me make this right...
say:6:1622527005:1.female: So it happened... the worst of it! This is my fault! Magister, you freed me from the corruption. Maybe... maybe you can help me make this right...

say:7:1622527006:1.text: Years ago, I was gravely wounded in this forest. Perri saved my life. I swore an owl knight's oath to repay his kindness.
say:7:1622527006:1.source_cn: 许多年前，我在森林中身受重伤濒临死亡，是皮瑞先生救了我...
say:7:1622527006:1.male: Years ago, I was gravely wounded in this forest. Perri saved my life. I swore an owl knight's oath to repay his kindness.
say:7:1622527006:1.female: Years ago, I was gravely wounded in this forest. Perri saved my life. I swore an owl knight's oath to repay his kindness.

say:8:1622527007:1.text: But then a dark force took root in the woods. The giant tree fell under its influence and began to lose itself. Perri kept watch day and night, trying to help it hold on to its last shred of sanity while it slept.
say:8:1622527007:1.source_cn: 后来，森林里出现了一股黑暗力量，巨树大人不幸受其腐化，...
say:8:1622527007:1.male: But then a dark force took root in the woods. The giant tree fell under its influence and began to lose itself. Perri kept watch day and night, trying to help it hold on to its last shred of sanity while it slept.
say:8:1622527007:1.female: But then a dark force took root in the woods. The giant tree fell under its influence and began to lose itself. Perri kept watch day and night, trying to help it hold on to its last shred of sanity while it slept.

say:9:1622527008:1.text: One day, while the giant tree slept, strangers entered the forest. Perri thought they were lost travelers and went to help... They attacked him before he could even speak.
say:9:1622527008:1.source_cn: 然而，在巨树大人沉眠期间，一伙外来者进入森林。善良的皮...
say:9:1622527008:1.male: One day, while the giant tree slept, strangers entered the forest. Perri thought they were lost travelers and went to help... They attacked him before he could even speak.
say:9:1622527008:1.female: One day, while the giant tree slept, strangers entered the forest. Perri thought they were lost travelers and went to help... They attacked him before he could even speak.

say:10:1622527009:1.text: By the time I got to him, he was barely alive... and the same corruption that afflicted the tree was spreading over him.
say:10:1622527009:1.source_cn: 当我发现皮瑞先生时，他已奄奄一息，身上浮现出与巨树同源...
say:10:1622527009:1.male: By the time I got to him, he was barely alive... and the same corruption that afflicted the tree was spreading over him.
say:10:1622527009:1.female: By the time I got to him, he was barely alive... and the same corruption that afflicted the tree was spreading over him.

say:11:1622527010:1.text: With the last of his strength, he gave me <style="highlight">a letter</style>. He begged me to <style="highlight">deliver it to the giant tree</style> the moment it woke.
say:11:1622527010:1.male: With the last of his strength, he gave me <style="highlight">a letter</style>. He begged me to <style="highlight">deliver it to the giant tree</style> the moment it woke.
say:11:1622527010:1.female: With the last of his strength, he gave me <style="highlight">a letter</style>. He begged me to <style="highlight">deliver it to the giant tree</style> the moment it woke.

say:12:1622527011:1.text: He said humans are far too fragile... and he wouldn't live long enough to see his old friend open its eyes again.
say:12:1622527011:1.source_cn: 他说“人类的生命远比巨树脆弱，他恐怕等不到老朋友醒来的...
say:12:1622527011:1.male: He said humans are far too fragile... and he wouldn't live long enough to see his old friend open its eyes again.
say:12:1622527011:1.female: He said humans are far too fragile... and he wouldn't live long enough to see his old friend open its eyes again.

say:13:1622527012:1.text: I set out to deliver that letter, but something attacked me on the way, corrupting me. Everything after that was a blur... Even so, one thought kept flickering in the back of my mind... I still had a promise to keep.
say:13:1622527012:1.source_cn: 我肩负重托前去送信，却在途中遭到袭击，也被腐化吞噬，从...
say:13:1622527012:1.male: I set out to deliver that letter, but something attacked me on the way, corrupting me. Everything after that was a blur... Even so, one thought kept flickering in the back of my mind... I still had a promise to keep.
say:13:1622527012:1.female: I set out to deliver that letter, but something attacked me on the way, corrupting me. Everything after that was a blur... Even so, one thought kept flickering in the back of my mind... I still had a promise to keep.

say:14:1622527013:1.text: You carry Perri's magic on you. That must be why I went after you... I mistook you for whatever took him.
say:14:1622527013:1.source_cn: 您的身上，有皮瑞先生的笔迹魔力气息……我想这是我袭击您...
say:14:1622527013:1.male: You carry Perri's magic on you. That must be why I went after you... I mistook you for whatever took him.
say:14:1622527013:1.female: You carry Perri's magic on you. That must be why I went after you... I mistook you for whatever took him.

choice_prompt:15:1622527013.text: You carry Perri's magic on you. That must be why I went after you... I mistook you for whatever took him.
choice_prompt:15:1622527013.source_cn: 您的身上，有皮瑞先生的笔迹魔力气息……我想这是我袭击您的原因。
choice_prompt:15:1622527013.male: You carry Perri's magic on you. That must be why I went after you... I mistook you for whatever took him.
choice_prompt:15:1622527013.female: You carry Perri's magic on you. That must be why I went after you... I mistook you for whatever took him.

say:16:1622527014:1.text: I see... the handwriting carries the same magical energy as the letter. No wonder I misunderstood what was going on.
say:16:1622527014:1.source_cn: 原来如此……记录上的笔迹与信件上的笔迹有着同源的气息，...
say:16:1622527014:1.male: I see... the handwriting carries the same magical energy as the letter. No wonder I misunderstood what was going on.
say:16:1622527014:1.female: I see... the handwriting carries the same magical energy as the letter. No wonder I misunderstood what was going on.

say:17:1622527015:1.text: Thank you for freeing me from that darkness. But I failed Perri. This truth should have reached the giant tree long ago... It's been drowning in guilt all this time.
say:17:1622527015:1.source_cn: 感谢您将我从黑暗的枷锁中解放。可是……我未能完成皮瑞先...
say:17:1622527015:1.male: Thank you for freeing me from that darkness. But I failed Perri. This truth should have reached the giant tree long ago... It's been drowning in guilt all this time.
say:17:1622527015:1.female: Thank you for freeing me from that darkness. But I failed Perri. This truth should have reached the giant tree long ago... It's been drowning in guilt all this time.

say:18:1622527016:1.text: There is... one thing I must ask of you.
say:18:1622527016:1.male: There is... one thing I must ask of you.
say:18:1622527016:1.female: There is... one thing I must ask of you.

say:19:1622527017:1.text: Perri sealed that letter with powerful protection magic. Time can weather everything else in this forest, but not that. It's still out there, waiting to be found. Please... bring it back!
say:19:1622527017:1.source_cn: 那封信被皮瑞先生注入了守护魔力，即便历经岁月洗刷，也绝...
say:19:1622527017:1.male: Perri sealed that letter with powerful protection magic. Time can weather everything else in this forest, but not that. It's still out there, waiting to be found. Please... bring it back!
say:19:1622527017:1.female: Perri sealed that letter with powerful protection magic. Time can weather everything else in this forest, but not that. It's still out there, waiting to be found. Please... bring it back!

choice_prompt:20:1622527017.text: Perri sealed that letter with powerful protection magic. Time can weather everything else in this forest, but not that. It's still out there, waiting to be found. Please... bring it back!
choice_prompt:20:1622527017.source_cn: 那封信被皮瑞先生注入了守护魔力，即便历经岁月洗刷，也绝不会湮灭。恳请您一定要找到它！
choice_prompt:20:1622527017.male: Perri sealed that letter with powerful protection magic. Time can weather everything else in this forest, but not that. It's still out there, waiting to be found. Please... bring it back!
choice_prompt:20:1622527017.female: Perri sealed that letter with powerful protection magic. Time can weather everything else in this forest, but not that. It's still out there, waiting to be found. Please... bring it back!

say:21:1622527018:1.text: Magister... I don't even know how to thank you. If there ever comes a day you need my wings, my claws, or my life... they're yours!
say:21:1622527018:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人……我……这份恩情，难以言表……若您日后有需...
say:21:1622527018:1.male: Magister... I don't even know how to thank you. If there ever comes a day you need my wings, my claws, or my life... they're yours!
say:21:1622527018:1.female: Magister... I don't even know how to thank you. If there ever comes a day you need my wings, my claws, or my life... they're yours!

choice:20:1:2.text: Don't beat yourself up. I'll take it from here!
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 不必苛责自己，交给我吧！
choice:20:1:2.male: Don't beat yourself up. I'll take it from here!
choice:20:1:2.female: Don't beat yourself up. I'll take it from here!

choice:5:1:2.male: (Explain how the giant tree went berserk)
choice:5:1:2.female: (Explain how the giant tree went berserk)

choice:2:0:1.male: What letter are you talking about?
choice:2:0:1.female: What letter are you talking about?

say:23:1622527003:1.male: Attack you? I... I did that?
say:23:1622527003:1.female: Attack you? I... I did that?

choice:2:1:2.male: Why did you attack me just now?
choice:2:1:2.female: Why did you attack me just now?

say:0:1622528001:0.text: If I follow the magical trail in Perri's research log, I might be able to find the letter.
say:0:1622528001:0.source_cn: 追踪与研究记录中的笔迹魔力同源的气息，或许能找到皮瑞的信。
say:0:1622528001:0.male: If I follow the magical trail in Perri's research log, I might be able to find the letter.
say:0:1622528001:0.female: If I follow the magical trail in Perri's research log, I might be able to find the letter.

say:0:1622529001:0.text: His magic is faint... I'll have to concentrate.
say:0:1622529001:0.source_cn: 皮瑞的魔力气息……很微弱，仔细感受。
say:0:1622529001:0.male: His magic is faint... I'll have to concentrate.
say:0:1622529001:0.female: His magic is faint... I'll have to concentrate.

say:0:1622530001:0.text: It's getting stronger. It has to be nearby!
say:0:1622530001:0.source_cn: 气息越来越强烈了，一定就在附近！

say:0:1622530001:0.female: It's getting stronger. It has to be nearby!

narration:0:1622531001:1.male: With a bit of magic, the worn old letter begins to return to its original form...
narration:0:1622531001:1.female: With a bit of magic, the worn old letter begins to return to its original form...

say:0:1622532001:0.text: This letter should've reached Talking Root long ago.
say:0:1622532001:0.source_cn: 唉，这封信迟到了太久……一定要让根语看到。
say:0:1622532001:0.male: This letter should've reached Talking Root long ago.
say:0:1622532001:0.female: This letter should've reached Talking Root long ago.
